## Summary

Gigabyte Technology is a Taiwanese company headquartered in Xindian District, New Taipei City, established in 1986 by Pei-Cheng Yeh and listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange [1]. Motherboards are its principal business; it also makes graphics cards, laptops, GPU servers and server motherboards, with Aorus and Giga Computing as subsidiaries [1].

The registry holds 21 MA-L blocks under GIGA-BYTE TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD. at Taiwanese addresses, two under GIGA-BYTE TECHNOLOGY CO. , Ltd. and one under GIGA-BYTE TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. at a California address [2]. A MAC in a Gigabyte block is most likely the onboard network interface of a Gigabyte motherboard, server board or laptop, but the network silicon Gigabyte fits is not documented in the sources consulted [1].

In May 2023 Eclypsium reported that Gigabyte system firmware drops a Windows executable at startup which downloads and runs further payloads without signature verification and over a path open to man-in-the-middle, first counting 271 and later 406 affected models [3][1]. FCC grantee codes are not listed because the FCC ID databases and gigabyte.com refused the session that wrote this entry; nothing is filled in from memory. Randomization is the host operating system's behaviour and is unknown here.
